resources.string: Android location permission lets Hello Kitty VPN read the connected Wi-Fi network name (SSID). The app compares it with your trusted networks to start the VPN on untrusted Wi-Fi, including while a VPN session runs in the background where Android permits access. Network names and your trusted list stay on this device and are not sent to any server. GPS coordinates are not requested. You can decline and connect the VPN manually, or turn this feature off in Settings.

Hello Kitty VPN reads the list of installed apps, including system apps such as Android Auto, so you can choose which apps use or bypass the VPN. App names, icons and package identifiers are used locally for this selection and to label per-app traffic counters and are not sent to any server or used for advertising. Without access you can still use the VPN for all apps.
Choose apps, including system apps, to use or bypass VPN. The installed app list stays on this device.
